children: Israel's annual inflation rate (ILCPIY=ECI) held steady in August at a five-year low of 1.5%, according to data on Tuesday from the Central Bureau of Statistics, a level that could support further interest rate reductions.
The August rate was below expectations of 1.6% in a Reuters poll, is within the government's annual target range of 1% to 3% and was at the lowest rate since May 2021 for a second straight month.
The consumer price index (ILCPI=ECI) rose 0.7% in August from July.

The Bank of Israel next meets on interest rates on October 21. It has cut the key rate by 25 basis points at its last three decisions to 3.25%. Central bank officials have said they could reduce the rate further should inflation remain contained.
